descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-09 step 3 and ER 3; TFA-92587 AC 4 · “Search over All Residents can add any resident to today”. Mixed: stated part — Search over All Residents adds the tapped resident to today; our part — A Hospital patient's name finding nothing in Nursing Home (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S02 Search All Residents, add one of two similarly named residents to today; a Hospital name finds nothing

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Search over All Residents can add any resident to today. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 4; TFA-92587 How it works 4)
  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 2; TFA-92587 How it works 2; TFA-92587 How it works 6)
  • U8 Nursing Home only. Hospital has no attendance toggle, no Today's Visits / All Residents tabs and no supervisor-list photo. (UAT TC-09 (title); UAT 3.3; TFA-92587 AC 7)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fixture resident (In Today); QA Ash (Maple 1) and QA Ashby (Maple 2), both not In Today; one Hospital patient

When All Residents → type 'Ash' into 'Search patients' → tap '+ Today' on QA Ash (not QA Ashby) → search the Hospital patient's full name → clear search → Today's Visits

Then The search returns both QA Ash and QA Ashby with '+ Today'. Only the tapped resident, QA Ash, joins Today's Visits; QA Ashby stays off. A Hospital patient's name finds no resident in Nursing Home

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: s02-search-hit lists both near-names by their exact card names (U4); s02-search-hospital has no chart button for the Hospital patient (U8); s02-today-after has QA Ash and the fixture resident and not QA Ashby, and mustNotContain 'In Today ✓' to prove the tab (U4, U5)

Where it ran: dev unit U08; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
